units: <cite ref="Shabbat 130a:12">Sabb. 130ᵃ</cite> <he>גזרה … על המ׳</he> the government decreed a prohibition against circumcision.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 19:2">Ib. XIX, 2</cite> <he>עושין כל צרכי מ׳ וכ׳</he> you may do on the Sabbath whatever is necessary in connection with circumcision (of a child on his eighth day). Ib. 24ᵇ, a. fr. <he>מ׳ שלא בזמנה</he> a circumcision not taking place on the eighth day. Ib. 118ᵇ <he>במ׳ שלי</he> at my membrum; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:11:4">Y. Meg. I, 72ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>במִילָתוֹ</he>; a. v. fr.—[<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 3:8">Targ. Cant. III, 8</cite> <he>חתימת מ׳</he> the seal of the covenant of circumcision.]—Pl. <he>מִילוֹת</he>.
Y. Sabb. XIX, 17ᵃ מיכן לשני מ׳ וכ׳ from this (himmol yimmol, Gen. XVII, 13, lammuloth, Ex. IV, 26) we learn that the act of circumcision is a complicated one, one that of cutting &c.
